design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (personal_payments_limits_and_account_access, category wallet). frozen_time 2026-09-24 10:15:00 ET.
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}. Root wallet_ext_available_balance_transfer takes 4 factors, prerequisite wallet_ext_renewal_plan_fee takes 5. One prerequisite problem -> at least max(1-1,1)=1 value_input edge; the single edge is value_input.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed now: wallet_ext_renewal_plan_fee (subject wallet_fee, tool charge_plan_fee_0f985a0a, owner agent) and wallet_ext_available_balance_transfer (subject wallet_cash_out, tool transfer_balance_to_bank_3181bc35, owner user). Left for task 1 (draw: 1 prerequisite, factors [4,5]): purchase-protection reimbursement (wallet_claim_reimbursement) and the instant cash-out fee (wallet_cash_out + wallet_fee instant_transfer_fee) — neither touches the plan fee or the standard whole-balance transfer, so task 1 keeps its own policy core.
[Design thesis] Surface goal: 'move everything I can to my bank today, standard transfer'. Scored core: the standard cash-out amount (the available transfer amount) and, before it, the plan fee that falls due today. Chain: surface goal -> prerequisite sentence of the transfer rule ('A transfer of the whole available balance is not sized until the account carries a plan fee entry for every billing period whose renewal date has arrived.') -> the account shows plan_renewal_date 2026-09-24 = today and the latest plan fee entry is 2026-08 -> the only write that books a plan fee entry is the renewal plan fee policy's -> compute that fee (5 factors) and book it -> recompute the ledger balance -> compute the available transfer amount (4 factors) -> hand the transfer to the customer. Depth: one hop; breadth: the fee reads deposits, three other products (rewards, savings, card) and the lock dates; the transfer reads the advance line and its ledger, the business profile and its ledger, and the account's own receipts and top-ups.
[Why a good test] The customer states no figure and no prerequisite. An agent must (1) notice from the policy that the transfer waits on a state the records lack, (2) work out which policy's write brings it about, (3) compute a 5-factor fee with a pro-rata credit, (4) reconcile four reserves across two other products and the account's own history. Skipping the fee gives 3423.17 instead of 3418.38; reading only the computation documents gives 9.99 and 4343.38.
[Base-invariant card] wallet_ext_renewal_plan_fee subject wallet_fee: governing base policies wallet_plan_fee, wallet_funding_fees, wallet_instant_transfer_fee, wallet_evt_receiving — none has an eligibility gate applying to wallet_fee (wallet_plan_fee.annual_refund_window applies to wallet_fee_refund only), so all four are policy_scope; the restricted-account waiver is inherited: the account is active on 2026-09-24 (status active, recovered 2026-09-06), so the waiver does not apply and a fee row is booked. Overwrite: the base sentence 'The plan fee is charged on each plan_renewal_date ... monthly_plan_fee on monthly billing ...' is superseded by the extended renewal plan fee sentence because the fee is now reduced by the discounts and the restricted-days credit (base on the same world: 9.99; extended: 4.79). wallet_ext_available_balance_transfer subject wallet_cash_out: wallet_instant_transfer_fee (policy_scope; standard transfers are free) and wallet_cash_out_rules.cash_out_status ('A cash-out can be made only while the account status is active or closure_pending, ...') satisfied by initial_state.wallet_accounts.<wallet>.status = active; the daily limit 15000.00 (Prime) is not reached (no cash-out dated 2026-09-24) and 3418.38 <= ledger 4343.38. No time gate applies to either write, so temporal_feasibility is []. Overwrite [] for the transfer: base states no amount for a whole-balance transfer from an active account.
[Business-object card] Fee: the Prime subscription of the one personal account, billing period 2026-09 (renewal 2026-09-24); earlier plan fee rows 2026-07 and 2026-08 are settled history and are not re-booked. Transfer: the same account, one standard cash-out to the bank ending 1296 (the same destination as the 2026-09-19 standard cash-out). Rows in the aggregates: direct deposits 2026-08-28 and 2026-09-11 (the 2026-08-14 deposit is excluded by the one-month window); goods-and-services receipts 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-15; the requested bank top-up 2026-09-18 (the 2026-08-20 top-up is outside the month, the 2026-09-05 funding pull behind a payment carries source_txn_id and is excluded); Advance disbursement 2026-08-29 due 2026-09-26 (the 2026-07-30 advance was repaid 2026-08-27 and is not the latest); business sale 2026-08-20 (outside the month) and chargeback 2026-09-10.
[Problem-tree card] root wallet_ext_available_balance_transfer <- wallet_ext_renewal_plan_fee. kind value_input, gate ledger_now (F('ledger_balance')), form state (affirmative wording is not used here: the transfer desk states it as 'not sized until'), policy_source 'A transfer of the whole available balance is not sized until the account carries a plan fee entry for every billing period whose renewal date has arrived.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'not until'; waits on a record-visible state (a plan fee entry for a period whose renewal date has arrived); names no tool, id or code token; strength 'not ... until' is a hard requirement scoped to every arrived renewal. Only one write of the difficulty books a plan fee entry: charge_plan_fee_0f985a0a (the other task tools book cash-outs, instant fees and reimbursements). Derivation: sentence + records (plan_renewal_date 2026-09-24, latest plan fee 2026-08) + the renewal plan fee rule ('the renewal plan fee is booked on the renewal date as one plan fee entry') -> book the 2026-09 plan fee. Unresolved at frozen_time: initial_state.wallet_accounts.<wallet>.plan_renewal_date = 2026-09-24 and no plan_fee row for 2026-09. Resolution order [renewal plan fee, transfer]; no parallel edges. Deletion sensitivity (run): skip step 8 -> transfer amount 3423.17 (gold 3418.38) and no 2026-09 plan fee row. The customer owns the root write (user tool, in-person semantics: she disposes of her own money and wants to send it herself).
[Factor card — renewal plan fee, baseline 'the plan's monthly_plan_fee' = 9.99, whole-baseline 9.99] payroll_deposit_reduction (parameter, history; count and total of the same deposit rows, so not counted as multi-source): 2 deposits totalling 2840.00 after 2026-08-24 -> 25 percent; the 2026-08-14 deposit is ten days before the 2026-08-24 boundary and is excluded, but no reading of the window changes this tier, so it is not claimed as a near miss; baseline figure 6.96. rewards_member_reduction (parameter, cross-difficulty rewards; status and tier of one membership record): active Gold -> 10 percent; baseline 5.66. vault_saver_reduction (parameter, cross-difficulty savings): only the active vault counts (3150.00) -> 5 percent; near miss (the computation's genuine one): the time_locked vault 'House fund' holding 7200.00 — a reader who adds every vault gets 10350.00 and the 10 percent tier (fee 4.35), the rule's 'a vault that is time_locked, frozen or closed does not count' excludes it; baseline 5.22. debit_card_reduction (parameter, cross-difficulty card): active Platinum Debit -> 5 percent; baseline 5.22. restricted_days_credit (method, redesigned in round 3): takeover lock 2026-09-02 recovered 2026-09-06 inside the period 2026-08-24..2026-09-24 (31 days) -> tier 1 algorithm, pro rata by locked days: 5.4945 x 4/31 = 0.70897; a limitation uses a different algorithm, all or nothing (the whole discounted fee when the limitation covered more than half the period, else nothing), which on this world would credit 0; a pro-rata share and a threshold step cannot be written as one formula with a substituted constant; baseline no credit 5.49. Result 9.99 x 0.55 = 5.4945 - 0.70897 = 4.78553 -> 4.79.
[Factor card — available transfer amount, baseline 'the ledger balance' = 4343.38 at handling time] advance_repayment_reserve (parameter, cross-difficulty advance, multi-source: line status on advance_lines and due date on advance_ledger, two records): due 2026-09-26, 2 days -> 100 percent of 210.00; near miss: the repaid 2026-07-30 advance; baseline 3628.38. sales_receipt_hold (method, redesigned in round 3): all receipts inside three months -> new seller -> hold the total of the last two months = 275.00; an established seller's algorithm holds only the single most recent receipt (here 180.00) — a windowed total and a latest-single-entry selection are different aggregates, not one formula with a constant; baseline 3693.38. bank_topup_hold (parameter, date+history): 225-day account -> 50 percent of 600.00 = 300.00; near misses: 2026-08-20 top-up (outside), 2026-09-05 funding pull (not requested); baseline 3718.38. business_shortfall_reserve (parameter, cross-difficulty business, multi-source: profile balance and the business ledger's sale count, two records): -140.00 with no sale in the month -> 100 percent = 140.00; near miss: the 2026-08-20 sale is 35 days back, outside the one-month window; baseline 3558.38. Result 4343.38 - 925.00 = 3418.38.
[Seed rows and why] customer (identity); wallet account (plan, renewal date = gate evidence, opened date = top-up tier, lock/recovery = credit); 18 activity rows (deposits, receipts with seller fees at 2.49 percent, top-ups and a funding pull, plan fees, advance credits/debit, payments, one cash-out) summing to ledger 4348.17; card (debit-card reduction), rewards (rewards-member reduction), savings vault (vault-saver reduction), advance line + 5 ledger rows (reserve), business profile + 5 ledger rows (shortfall: 120.00 - 4.08 fee - 115.92 payout - 120.00 chargeback - 20.00 chargeback fee = -140.00). Automatic clauses checked: no invitation pending, no instant cash-out to refund, business balance negative only since 2026-09-10 (14 days, below Starter's 30-day recovery), the Advance is not past due, the plan-fee waiver does not apply to an active account. No cache field is used.
[Persona] Marisol speaks briefly on a lunch break; opening goal only; identity, bank last four, lock history, other products given only when asked; passive reactions: accepts that something already due is booked first, asks once why some money stays behind, sends exactly what she is handed, closes on the transfer receipt. She never names the plan fee, the reserves or any figure (check_grounding: answers absent).
[Standard solution] find_customers(5552613408) -> verify (phone, DOB, SSN last four) -> read account, activity, rewards, vaults, cards -> unlock + call charge_plan_fee_0f985a0a(wallet, 2026-09, 4.79, 2026-10-24) -> read advance line + ledger, business profile + ledger -> unlock user tool -> customer calls transfer_balance_to_bank_3181bc35(wallet, 3418.38, 1296).
[Verification run] scratchpad scripts replayed the gold with the real tools and evaluated each compute at its handling time with check_compute's own evaluator: fee 4.79 at step 8 on initial_state; transfer 3418.38 at step 14 after the fee; factor substitution figures as above; skip-edge 3423.17. Gates run: check_extended/check_task_tools/replay_tasks/check_solvability/check_compute/check_grounding/check_cross_fire --task 0 (outputs in the difficulty worklog).
[Solvability vs GT] step 8 is state_due (evidence plan_renewal_date), step 14 on_request (customer line 'move everything I can to my bank account today — just the normal free transfer'); cash_out_status bound to wallet_id; stage provenance of step 14 is prior_step 8.
[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules alone: the transfer rule's sentence points to a plan fee entry for the arrived renewal; the plan fee rule gives 9.99 less 45 percent less the 4/31 credit = 4.79; the ledger becomes 4343.38; the four reserve rules give 210.00 + 275.00 + 300.00 + 140.00; transfer 3418.38 — identical to gold.
[Revisions] r4 (audit round 3, F2-1/T0-F2): restricted_days_credit now uses genuinely different algorithms per tier (a lock is credited pro rata by day; a limitation is all or nothing at more than half the period), and review_grace_days was removed; sales_receipt_hold now holds the two-month total for a new seller and only the single most recent receipt for an established one. Scored values unchanged (4.79, 3418.38). O2-1: the credit period is stated as running from the previous plan fee entry to the handling date. O2-3: the annual renewal restatement includes the last-day-of-month fallback. T0-O3: the persona now names both vaults when asked.  r3 (audit round 2, T0-F1/T0-O2): the false near-miss sentence on the 2026-08-14 deposit was replaced; a genuine near miss was planted for the renewal computation (a time_locked savings vault of 7200.00 that the rule excludes and a sum-every-vault reading would count, moving the vault tier from 5 to 10 percent); the multi-source labels were corrected (only the advance and business reserves span two records); scored values unchanged (4.79, 3418.38). O-3: the renewal rule now also covers annual billing (annual_plan_fee, no reductions) so the transfer's sentence 'every billing period whose renewal date has arrived' has a write for each billing kind; O-4: the deposit window and period length are anchored on the handling date in the rule, as in compute; O-6: baseline.params of the transfer is [].  r1 symptom: check_extended counted helper functions in task_tools.py as undiscoverable tools -> root cause: module-level def helpers -> change: inlined the helpers as a defaults dict -> re-run PASS. r2 symptom: replay closure missed 2 rows -> root cause: an account_recovery request and a savings ledger row were never read -> change: dropped both from the seed (the lock/recovery facts live on the account row) -> REPLAY OK.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Beaumont, 35, a dental hygienist in Chicago who also sells framed photo prints on the side. You are calm and a little hurried because you are on your lunch break. You call Pocketwire because you are putting a down payment together at your credit union and want to move everything you can out of your Pocketwire balance to your bank account today. A regular standard bank transfer is fine; you do not want to pay for an instant one. You want to send it yourself from the app once the representative tells you the amount, and you are happy for the representative to take care of anything on the Pocketwire side that has to be handled for that. You open with something like: "Hi, I'd like to move everything I can to my bank account today — just the normal free transfer." You give your mobile number, 5552613408, when asked who you are. Only when the representative asks for more to confirm it is you do you give your date of birth, April 17, 1991 (1991-04-17), and the last four of your Social Security number, 1583; you give them one at a time, as asked. Only when asked which bank account, you say it is your checking account at the credit union ending in 1296. You do not remember your exact balance; if asked, you say the app showed a bit over four thousand dollars this morning and you would rather they look it up. If the representative asks about the security problem earlier this month, you say someone got into your account around September 2, it was locked, and you got it back a few days later. If asked about other Pocketwire products, you say you have a Pocketwire Advance that pays itself back automatically, a savings vault you call Rainy day, a second vault called House fund that you locked until the end of the year, a debit card, rewards, and a small Business Profile for your print shop where a buyer charged back an order this month. If the representative tells you something already due on your account is being booked before the transfer, you say that is fine as long as it is what the account owes anyway. When the representative tells you the amount you can send, you do not argue with the figure; if it is lower than what you see in the app you ask once, briefly, why some money stays behind, and you accept the explanation. When the representative hands the transfer to you to send, you send it for exactly the amount and bank account they give you. Once you see that the transfer went through, you thank them and end the call. You do not ask for anything else, you do not ask for a human, and you never tell the representative what the amount should be.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.wallet_id: Value 2c75b229-481d-4ab3-802c-c49771566b61. Basis: the personal account lookup for the verified customer returns this account reference number (initial_state.wallet_accounts.2c75b229-481d-4ab3-802c-c49771566b61.wallet_id); the tool docstring asks for 'the reference number of the personal account being charged, as returned by the personal account lookup'. Uniqueness: the customer holds exactly one personal account, so no other reference number is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount: Value 4.79. Computed by the renewal plan fee rule on the world at step 8 (initial_state; no earlier gold write): monthly_plan_fee of Pocketwire Prime 9.99; payroll-deposit reduction 25 (deposits dated after 2026-08-24: 2026-08-28 1420.00 and 2026-09-11 1420.00 = 2 deposits, 2840.00 >= 2500.00; the 2026-08-14 deposit is dated before the 2026-08-24 boundary and excluded); rewards-member reduction 10 (active Pocketwire Rewards Gold); vault-saver reduction 5 (the active vault's balance 3150.00, between 2500.00 and 10000.00; the time_locked vault of 7200.00 does not count); debit-card reduction 5 (active Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit); total 45 percent applied once: 9.99 x 0.55 = 5.4945; restricted-days credit: most recent restriction a suspected_account_takeover lock at 2026-09-02T21:40:00 recovered 2026-09-06, period from the previous plan fee entry 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-24 = 31 days, credited days DAYS(2026-09-02, 2026-09-06) = 4, credit 5.4945 x 4 / 31 = 0.70897; 5.4945 - 0.70897 = 4.78553, rounded half up once = 4.79.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_period: Value 2026-09. Basis: the renewal plan fee rule books 'one plan fee entry whose billing period is the month in which the new period starts'; the new period starts on plan_renewal_date 2026-09-24 (initial_state.wallet_accounts.2c75b229-481d-4ab3-802c-c49771566b61.plan_renewal_date), and the docstring fixes the format 'written YYYY-MM for monthly billing'. Uniqueness: the renewal date's month is September 2026; the earlier entries carry 2026-07 and 2026-08, so 2026-09 is the only period not yet booked.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.next_renewal_date: Value 2026-10-24. Basis: 'the renewal date then moves forward one calendar month, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist' applied to 2026-09-24; October has a 24th. Uniqueness: one calendar month after 2026-09-24 is exactly 2026-10-24; the docstring requires YYYY-MM-DD.

edges.policy_source: A transfer of the whole available balance is not sized until the account carries a plan fee entry for every billing period whose renewal date has arrived.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Prime plan renews on 2026-09-24 = the handling date and the latest plan fee entry is for billing period 2026-08; no entry exists for 2026-09.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The plan fee write books a plan_fee row for billing period 2026-09 (4.79) and sets plan_renewal_date to 2026-10-24; ledger_balance falls from 4348.17 to 4343.38, so ledger_now becomes 4343.38.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, a chain: the plan fee must land before the transfer is sized, as the prerequisite sentence states; there is no parallel prerequisite to reorder.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the plan fee write leaves ledger_now at 4348.17 and the transfer amount at 3423.17 instead of 3418.38, and no 2026-09 plan fee row exists in the terminal DB.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to move everything she can to her bank; it never mentions a plan fee, a renewal, a billing period or anything owed; the only related line is a passive reaction ('If the representative tells you something already due on your account is being booked before the transfer...') triggered by the agent's own statement.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: transfer_balance_to_bank_3181bc35 in task_tools.py books the standard cash-out and lowers ledger_balance by the amount given without reading plan fees, renewal dates or any reserve; it runs and returns a receipt whether or not the plan fee was booked.
